signal: Alliance Solutions Group, part of the TalentLaunch network, runs multiple staffing brands across legal, manufacturing, IT and finance verticals

email.subject1: pipeline Alliance is leaving on the table
email.body1:
Andrew, with Alliance Solutions Group running multiple staffing brands across the TalentLaunch network, you are covering more verticals than any one SDR team can personally touch.

When a CRO owns coverage across legal, manufacturing, IT, and finance, in-market accounts always outnumber the reps available, and that is exactly where pipeline goes cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Alliance off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Andrew, quick follow-up for Alliance.

Across that many brands and verticals, the pipeline target usually outruns the reps you can hire and ramp. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book per vertical to hit the number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Alliance needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Andrew, last bit of proof for Alliance.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Alliance's reply rate likely compares to peer staffing teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Andrew, I will stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline across your brands without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Running coverage across that many verticals is its own kind of busy, and I get that timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a multi-brand motion? I will tailor it to Alliance either way.
